hints.tr: Seçme: `for value, count in counts.items():` içinde `best is None or count > best[1]` ise `best = (value, count)`.
hints.en: Choosing: inside `for value, count in counts.items():`, if `best is None or count > best[1]`, `best = (value, count)`.

hint.en: Do not use `.count()`; build a counter dictionary.
